title: Relative lifting of pointed etale morphisms
statement: Let A and B be commutative local rings in one universe, let π:A → B be surjective, and let K and L be separable closures of their respective residue fields. The A- and B-algebra structures factor through their residue fields as in [def-sc-ring-strict-henselization]. Let H be the pushout extension of scalars of [lem-sbc-surjective-quotient-base-change]. Fix a B-algebra isomorphism c:H(K) ≅ L and the explicit pointed functor F of [lem-sbc-pointed-etale-quotient-functor]. Given a pointed etale A-algebra S, a pointed etale B-algebra T and a pointed morphism f:F(S) → T, there exist a pointed etale A-algebra S′, a morphism g:S → S′ and a pointed isomorphism e:F(S′) ≅ T such that F(g) followed by e is f.

source.place: Tags 04D1 (lemma-lift-etale), 00U7 (maps between etale algebras) and 05WS; relative coefficient lifting and pushout pasting

proof.text: Let U underlie S and let V=H(U). The canonical U -> V is surjective by Mathlib stability of surjectivity under base change. Give T its V-algebra structure through f. Since V and T are etale over B, Etale.of_restrictScalars shows that T is etale over V.

Apply the explicit coefficient-lift theorem to U -> V and the V-algebra T. Its ring W is etale over U, with reduction square a ring pushout. Composition makes W etale over A. Paste this square with A -> U, B -> H(U) to identify H(W) with T, keeping the structure map from U. Transport the isomorphism through commAlgCatEquivUnder, composing with the unit isomorphism. Pushout hom-extensionality proves the equation H(g) followed by e equals f.

Lift the point e followed by T -> L and c inverse through quotientBaseChange_point_bijective. Its injectivity shows that g respects points, using that f does. Turn e into an Over isomorphism and then a full-subcategory isomorphism. The structure equation is unchanged on underlying maps.

theorem pointedEtaleQuotient_morphism_lift
    (A K B L : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [Field K]
    [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) K] [IsSepClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) K]
    [Algebra A K] [IsScalarTower A (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) K]
    [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing B] [Field L]
    [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B) L]
    [IsSepClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B) L]
    [Algebra B L] [IsScalarTower B (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B) L]
    (π : A →+* B) (hπ : Function.Surjective π)
    (c : (quotientBaseChange π).obj (CommAlgCat.of A K) ≅ CommAlgCat.of B L)
    (S : ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (fun X : Over (CommAlgCat.of A K) ↦ Etale A X.left))
    (T : ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (fun X : Over (CommAlgCat.of B L) ↦ Etale B X.left))
    (f : (pointedEtaleBaseChange π c.hom).obj S ⟶ T) :
    ∃ (S' : ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (fun X : Over (CommAlgCat.of A K) ↦ Etale A X.left))
      (g : S ⟶ S') (e : (pointedEtaleBaseChange π c.hom).obj S' ≅ T),
      (pointedEtaleBaseChange π c.hom).map g ≫ e.hom = f
